correctness.rationale: For k≥5 ternary digits, 16k<3^{k−1}≤n, so T(n)<n until n≤80. The exact image of numbers 1..80 is U={1,2,3,4,16,17,18,19,32,33,34,48,49,64}; the independently recomputed full fourteen-arrow graph closes on U and contains exactly 1, 16↔18, 17↔33. Every digit has d^4≡d (mod2), so parity is invariant and even inputs enter only 16↔18. These finite graph calculations prove the infinite statement only together with the strict descent argument.
